description: Elephant, the archivist, who keeps the town records and collects the gnu's scattered notes in the finale. Generic placeholders until WP9 fixes the finale's design; triggers note_found and handoff_solved are WP9 hooks.

pieces.speaker: Elephant
lines: Welcome to the archive. I keep the town's records. All of them. I never forget.
But the gnu never gave me his. His notes are scattered all over town.

pieces.speaker: Elephant
lines: Found one of his notes? Bring it here, and I'll file it where anyone can read it.
We don't need every note. Just enough. That's the good thing about lots of people.

pieces.speaker: Elephant
lines: Another one! Filed. Now it isn't only in his head. Or yours.

pieces.speaker: Elephant
lines: A new page for the README he never wrote.
He would be so embarrassed. And so pleased.

pieces.speaker: Elephant
lines: The README is finished. Not by one author. By all of you, a page at a time.
I'll keep it safe. That's my job. Keeping it running is yours now.
